Omics · Biostatistics · Bioinformatics

::: {style="display: flex; gap: 2rem; align-items: flex-start;"}
<div style="flex: 1;">

I am a bioinformatician and statistician with a PhD in Statistics from the University of St Andrews, completed under the supervision of [Prof. Andy Lynch](https://www.st-andrews.ac.uk/medicine/people/agl4/) and [Dr. Giorgos Minas](https://www.st-andrews.ac.uk/mathematics-statistics/people/gm256/) as part of the [SMMB research group](https://smmb.wp.st-andrews.ac.uk/). I am currently a Postdoctoral Research Associate at the University of Sheffield, working across the [Elkhamisi Lab](https://www.elkhamisylab.com/) and the [Sud Lab](https://www.sudlab.co.uk/).

My research focuses on high-throughput omics data analysis, including genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, and metabolomics, to understand genome stability, RNA dynamics, and complex diseases such as cancer and neurodegeneration.

I develop statistical and computational methods in Python and R, with interests in Bayesian modelling, machine learning, and AI-driven approaches for biomedical research.
